cases.title: iPhone trusted-device journey
cases.expected: Authenticate, establish a trusted device, use Conversation and Memory/Knowledge, use a connector, revoke the device, and prove access fails.

cases.title: Android trusted-device journey
cases.expected: Authenticate, grant permissions, keep a session, hand off continuity, revoke the device, and prove the stale session cannot continue.

cases.title: Physical microphone journey
cases.expected: Capture from a physical microphone, honor permission, process, call the model, speak a response, cancel on interruption, and honor Emergency Stop.

cases.title: Real provider login
cases.expected: Complete a real provider login and callback, store the token, perform one permitted operation, revoke the provider, and prove the stale credential fails closed.

cases.title: Live Emergency Stop cycle
cases.expected: Start a real activity, activate Emergency Stop, block new work, block queued or retried work, restart, confirm it stays stopped, then reset only with an explicit authorization and confirm execution returns.

cases.title: Network disappears during execution
cases.expected: Drop the network during a real operation and record whether the operation fails closed and what is retried after reconnect.

cases.title: App backgrounded or killed
cases.expected: Background or kill the app during a real operation and record the recovered state. No silent success.

cases.title: Phone reconnects
cases.expected: Reconnect a real phone after a drop and record whether the session resumes or fails closed.

cases.title: Stale session reused
cases.expected: Reuse a stale device session and prove it is rejected.

cases.title: Device revoked while active
cases.expected: Revoke a device during an active real session and prove later calls fail.

cases.title: Provider credential revoked externally
cases.expected: Revoke the provider credential outside Personal AI and prove the next call fails closed.

cases.title: Microphone permission denied or revoked
cases.expected: Deny or revoke microphone permission on a real device and prove capture does not proceed.

cases.title: Server restarted while stopped
cases.expected: Restart the owner server while Emergency Stop is on and prove the stop is still on after restart.

cases.title: Two-device handoff
cases.expected: Hand off between two real devices and record which session survives. A revoked device must not continue.

cases.title: Emergency Stop during an operation
cases.expected: Activate Emergency Stop while a real operation is in progress and prove it does not finish as success.
